sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Remove the sh:or branch that permits nltl:polarCodeApplies to be absent. Conditional alternatives must not pass when branch-selection evidence is missing; require exactly one xsd:boolean applicability value and retain the false and true branches, with certificate-present and certificate-status true required only in the true branch.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Prevent contradictory multi-valued booleans from satisfying the false applicability branch or the true certificate checks: constrain polarCodeApplies to exactly one boolean value, and in the applicable branch constrain each required certificate boolean to a single true value (e.g., sh:minCount 1, sh:maxCount 1, sh:hasValue true). Keep the conditional sh:or structure and ship target.

Replace the unconditional sh:minCount 1/sh:maxCount 1 constraint on nltl:polarCodeApplies with conditional logic that permits its absence when applicability is not evidenced. Do not require a convenience applicability boolean merely to validate this conditional obligation; when nltl:polarCodeApplies is present and true, require certificate presence true and certificate status true, while preserving the valid non-applicable branch.

Remove the sh:or branch that permits nltl:polarCodeApplies to be absent. Conditional alternatives must not pass when branch-selection evidence is missing; require exactly one xsd:boolean applicability value and retain the false and true branches, with certificate-present and certificate-status true required only in the true branch.
